translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Paila kabokwapusi
E iluki la toligalega, kawala, “Mokwita kabokwapusi bimaisi; mitaga wo! tau matauna uula bimaisi!
Ibodi sainela kidamwa bisipwaisi kwaitala uyuwa kwaiveka okaiyola e bilavaisi obolita, mitaga gala ibodi matauna bivakapusii taitala matausina tokikekita.
Kuyamataimi. “Kidamwa bodam kaina tuwam
bisula, kubuyoyu matauna; kidamwa bininavila, bukuligaiwa la mitugaga matauna.
Kidamwa bivagi sula baisa yoku biboda sivalima sivayu wa yam kwaitala, e sivalima sivayu bimakaiam bikaibiga, kawala, ‘Bogwa laninavila’, ibodaim bukuligaiwa la mitugaga.”
Paila dubumi
E aposetolo ilukwaisi Tomoya, kawasi, “Ma dubumaisi kukwatumkulovi!”
E Tomoya ivitakaula, kawala, “Kidamwa mi dubumi kala kwaiveka makawala waitunela mwaiya, gagabila bukulukwaisi makaina yaku, kawami, ‘Kukoulaim kulavaim obolita’, e bikabikuwolaimi.
Paila wotetila
“Kaina taitala mi towotetila ibigubagula kaina iiyamati sipi. Igau bima metoya obuyagu, ki, bukuluki matauna, kawami, ‘Nani kuma kukwam’?
Gala goli. Bukuluki matauna, kawami, ‘Kusulu kʹagu, e kukwatulova, kuyeyai kʹagu, kumai. Bakam, bamom; oluviga yoku.’
Ammakawala, bukunokagutoki baisa m towotetila paila ikabikuwoli karaiwaga kaina gala?
Makawala goli yokomi. Kidamwa bogwa lokuvigimkulovaisi avaka kami karaiwaga, bukukwaibigasi, kawami, ‘Yakidasi da wotetilasi sitana wala; paila bogwa tavagaisi makawala kada karaiwagasi wala.’”
Yesu ikatumigileu tailuwotala tokwagwaiguya
E tutala ililoula ilokaia Yerusalem, ivakana okaligeisi Sameria toyo Galili.
Tutala iviloubusi kwaitala valu, tailuwotala tokwagwaiguya ibodaisi matauna. Itotusi sita ewaiwa,
e ikapinivekasi, ikaibigasi, kawasi, “Yesu, Guyau, kunokapisaimasi.”
Tutala igisi, iluki matausina, kawala, “Kulosi, kuvitulokaimi baisa tolula.”
Mapaila ilosi. Ililoulasi, e ka, bogwa imigileusi.
E taitala matausina, tutala igisi leibwaina, ikaimilavau e deli kaigala kaigaveka iiyakawoli Yaubada.
Ikavagina omatala Yesu, inokagutoki; e matauna guma Sameria.
E Yesu ikawota, kawala, “Ki, gala akatumigileu tailuwotala? Mitaga ambaisa matausina tailima taivasi?
Gala taitala isisu bikaimilavau biyakawoli Yaubada, mitaga matauna togilagala wala ke?”
E iluki matauna, kawala, “Kutokaia, kula; m dubumi bogwa iyomovaim.”
Avai tuta Yaubada la Karaiwaga bima?
Parisi ikatupoiyaisi matauna avai tuta Yaubada la Karaiwaga bima. Yesu ivitakauloki matausina, kawala, “Gala bigisaki matila bitakateta Yaubada la Karaiwaga bimaima.
Gala bitakaibigasi, ‘Ka, baisa emaima!’ kaina ‘Ka, baisa ewaiwa!’ Paila ka, Yaubada la Karaiwaga isisu olumoulemi.”
Iluki toligalega, kawala, “Igau tuta bima bukupikwakusi bukugisaisi kwaitala ulo yam yeigu Latula Tomota, mitaga gala bukugisaisi makwaina.
E tomota bilukwaimi, kawasi, ‘Ka, baisa ewaiwa!’ kaina ‘Ka, baisa emaima!’ Taga kulosi, kaina bukubokulaisi matausina.
Paila yeigu Latula Tomota agu gigisa ogu yam
makawala kavikavila kidamwa bikavila e bititapi labuma metoya okwaibwaga baisa obomatu.
Mitaga ikugwa ibodi matauna bibani kala mmayuyu bidubadu, e tubwa matubona bipakaisi matauna.
Makawala ola tuta Nowa,
makawala goli yeigu Latula Tomota ogu tuta.
Ikamkwamsi imomomsi, iveivaisi, ipukupakusi, ee, yam makwaiwena Nowa isila ola waga, e leima dadoya, komwaidosi idoumlabasi.
Makawala goli ola tuta Lota,
ikamkwamsi, imomomsi, igigimwalasi, imipumapusi, isupusopusi, iiyoudilasi,
mitaga wa yam makwaina Lota isilavi Sodom, e kova kovalululu toyo salipa maiinela saina peuluvagasi ididabwalisi makawala kuna metoya wa labuma, e komwaidosi idoumlabasi.
E makawala bikaloubusi wa yam makwaina yeigu Latula Tomota bayoumatila.
“Wa yam makwaina, matauna isisu obuneyova
deli la guguwa olopola bwala, gala ibodi bikau makwaisina. Makawala matauna isisu obuyagu gala ibodi bikaimilavau.
Kululuwaisi la kwava Lota.
Availa mwada biyusi tatoula, matauna bitamwau; e availa bikitumou tatoula, matauna bimova goli.
Alukwaimi, wa bogi makwaina taiyu tauwau ikanuvadulisi bikanukwenusi okabasi kwaitala; Yaubada bikau taitala e taitalaga bikanam.
Nayu vivila bitutusi kasi witi bimila pwarawa; Yaubada bikau natana e natalaga bisim.”
Ikatupoiyaisi matauna, kawasi, “Tomoya, ambaisa?” Iluki matausina, kawala, “Ambaisa tomata bikanukwenu, baisa mluveka
bitogugulasi mwada bikamsi.”

footnotes.text: Ibodi bivituloki wowola baisa matausina tolula ola valu tatoula kaina tolula matausina iyamataisi Bwala Kwebumaboma mapilana Yerusalem.
isisu olumoulemi. Gagabila bitagini, “isisu oninami” kainaga “bima nanakwa bikaloubusi olumoulemi”.
agu gigisa ogu yam.Mimilisi buki pilabubogwa iginisi wala “agu gigisa” e gala ikatumkulovaisi “ogu yam”.
Omitibogwa Yaubada eikatudoum mina watanawa metoya wa dadoya, mitaga eikatumovi Nowa deli dalela.
Omitibogwa Yaubada eikatudoum mina Sodom deli mina Gomora metoya wa kova kovalululu, mitaga eikatumovi Lota deli dalela.
Buki pilabubogwa eiginisi “odabala bwala”, baisa goli pilapatata, e koyavi wala bimwenasi baisa biuvaiwasi tutala kalasia kala yuviyavi ibubusi. Mitaga yakidasi da kabovaiwasi kaina buneyova.
Minana gala eikabikuwoli Yaubada mauula eiboda kala kamwaga mwau eimila dakuna yonawokuva wala.
Mimilisi buki pilabubogwa ikatumkulovaisi mailela 36, iginisi, “ 36 Taiyu tauwau obuyagu bibigubagulasi; Yaubada bikau taitala e taitalaga bisim.”

Baisa mina Yudia si bigivakala, e kala katumiki baisa makawala — avai tuta vavagi kwevakaigaga bikaloubusi, nani wala tomota bilagaisi bulogala. Kaina avai tuta vavagi saina mwaugaga bikaloubusi tomota bidubadu bitoulaisi bitopataisi bitobu mitasi bigigisaisi wala. Mitaga mabigana “mluveka” tuvaila bikibuboti mabudona mina Roum si tokwabilia, e kaina Yesu ililivala paila mabudona igau bikatudoum mina Yudia.
